end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation in humans and plants.
Gave examples such as heart, digestive system, leaf, and muscle tissue.
Explained that tissues are made of cells and organs are made of tissues.
Correctly ordered cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism once independently.
Discussed Amoeba as a single-celled organism using pseudopodia for feeding and movement; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation using human and plant examples. Yash explained the cell-to-tissue-to-organ relationship and later corrected the mix-up between the heart and circulatory system. At home, ask them to arrange the five levels with one human and one plant example for each where possible.
